description: React component for displaying and managing health checks of models, including fetching status, running checks, and showing modals for errors and responses.

classes.name: HealthStatus
classes.description: Interface representing the health status of a model, including status, last check time, error info, and response.

classes.name: HealthCheckComponentProps
classes.description: Props interface for the HealthCheckComponent, including access token, model data, and callback functions.

methods.name: extractMeaningfulError
methods.description: Parses error messages to extract and format meaningful error information.

methods.name: runIndividualHealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check for a specific model, updates status, and fetches latest database info.

methods.name: runAllHealthChecks
methods.description: Runs health checks for all selected or all models, updates statuses, and refreshes from database.

methods.name: handleModelSelection
methods.description: Handles selection/deselection of individual models for health checks.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all models for health checks.

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Returns a Badge component representing the health status.

methods.name: showErrorModal
methods.description: Displays modal with detailed error information.

methods.name: showSuccessModal
methods.description: Displays modal with health check response details.
